name: failure-reading
title: The failure reading: what a request that went wrong left behind, and the request id a refusal never carried
description: AHE experience observability v1: attribute every gate refusal to the request it refused, then turn an unsuccessful request records into a bounded failure record with its typed mechanism, the refusals that preceded it, and a stated component attribution - and report an empty corpus as a finding rather than as a silent list
creator: aixi
